title: Adversarial Learned Fair Representations using Dampening and Stacking

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the removal of sentiment polarity (positive/negative) from sentence embeddings (Universal Sentence Encoder) in the ACL-IMDb movie review dataset using an adversarial representation learning algorithm, measured by the classification accuracy of an adversary and by analyzing the presence of sentiment-related words in K-Means topic clusters.

Simulating an image anonymization task by treating a specific digit class (the digit '8') in the MNIST dataset as a generic protected sensitive variable, evaluating the model's ability to censor this feature by measuring an adversary's classification accuracy against the mean squared reconstruction error.
